review: Retains all five package-declared test files and their 36 reported suite/test nodes, plus the shared complete Brotli/gzip/raw ESM profiles. The corpus loader requires 660 included examples. Existing exclusions are recorded; no test or case was removed. Passing these 75 nodes does not replace the additional required coverage below.
additionalRequiredCoverage: Complete closed-profile parse and parseInline corpus, option and public-boundary observations; existing closed tests cover only selected cases
Exact scored UMD bytes observed executing through the original VM/browser delivery boundary
Executable installed package-export resolution and complete deployment dependency coverage
